description.text: The second Scarlet & Violet set, released on 9 June 2023 with 279 cards. It centers on ex cards of the Paldea first partners, which reach their final forms as Meowscarada ex, Skeledirge ex and Quaquaval ex, and of the Ruinous Quartet, four Legendary Pokémon new to the ninth generation, among them Chien-Pao ex and Ting-Lu ex. Forretress, Slowking and Dedenne appear as Tera Pokémon ex, and Pikachu joins as a Pokémon ex.
